name: GWM
verdict: Run locally (and paid for locally) by Inchcape, the authorised GWM distributor in Chile. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: chest logo on Chile's rugby shirt; GWM Chile renewed its sponsorship in March 2026 (gwm.cl). In Chile the GWM operation is Inchcape's Vehículos de Trabajo S.A., 'authorised distributor of Great Wall Motors Chile' (claim inchcape-gwm-chile-ownership). The GWM car brand belongs to Great Wall Motor Company of China; the local sponsorship operation is Inchcape's. Neither party has a qualifying human-rights record found in the searches run.
